queries.sql: SELECT `open_trip_schedules`.*, `request_open_trips`.`user_id` as `requester_id`, `users`.`full_name` as `requester_name`, `schedules`.`departure_date`, `schedules`.`departure_time`, `boats`.`boat_name`, `boats`.`capacity`, `departure`.`island_name` as `departure_island`, `arrival`.`island_name` as `arrival_island` FROM `open_trip_schedules` JOIN `request_open_trips` ON `request_open_trips`.`request_id` = `open_trip_schedules`.`request_id` JOIN `users` ON `users`.`user_id` = `request_open_trips`.`user_id` JOIN `schedules` ON `schedules`.`schedule_id` = `open_trip_schedules`.`schedule_id` JOIN `boats` ON `boats`.`boat_id` = `schedules`.`boat_id` JOIN `routes` ON `routes`.`route_id` = `schedules`.`route_id` JOIN `islands` as `departure` ON `departure`.`island_id` = `routes`.`departure_island_id` JOIN `islands` as `arrival` ON `arrival`.`island_id` = `routes`.`arrival_island_id` ORDER BY `schedules`.`departure_date` ASC, `schedules`.`departure_time` ASC
